correctness.rationale: Unique root paths yield exact first moments. Conditional on non-outgoing randomness, each parent replaces its outgoing edges by iid Bernoulli(p), and the expectation of every convex final-count functional is convex in p by nonnegative mixed forward differences; coordinatewise convex-order comparisons follow. Joint infection for incomparable vertices has two outgoing contacts from their LCA and E[P²] rather than q², giving the stated nonnegative exact variance excess. Counting incomparable pairs proves sharp path/star topology extrema, and Var(P)≤q(1−q) with finite-duration near-Bernoulli construction proves sharp supremum. Exact rational code checks 1,441 representative trees and 15,684 assertions, not the infinite statement.

value.rationale: The result precisely quantifies when independent-edge epidemic uncertainty underestimates total outbreak-size risk despite predicting its mean exactly. The LCA branching coefficient gives a graph-computable correction and complete path/star extremizers at fixed population size, and convex-order domination controls all convex risks rather than only variance. The four-person rooted-star example produces 50% variance inflation with finite positive periods. This is a mathematically motivated distinction in infection forecasting, not a presentation of a trivial one-case calculation.
